subject: Opportunity hygiene cadence: confirm stage & close-date for flagged deals
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sales Team <sales-team@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Opportunity hygiene cadence: confirm stage & close-date for flagged deals

Team,

Quick hygiene check as we move into the last month of the quarter. I ran the flagged-opps view and exported deals that are $50k+ and show a close date in the next 90 days but have not been updated in the last 21 days. Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (10/13):

- Review the attached Q4_pipeline_flagged.csv and confirm for each row whether the deal is:
  * Realistic commit (leave stage/close date)
  * Push to next quarter (update close date + comment)
  * Archive/Mark lost

- If you need support or want me to run a targeted outreach, reply and tag CS and Rev Ops.
- Add a one-line rationale in the CSV comment column for any changes.

Two items I care about:
1) Accuracy in the forecast — we need to reduce surprise churn in the last two weeks.
2) Ownership clarity — if an opportunity is not active, please reassign or note the next action.

Link to the Salesforce view: https://salesforce.com/00O4x00000ExampleView
Google sheet (live tracker): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: Q4_pipeline_flagged.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)

—Aditya

Aditya — great question. For NimbleTech (row 14):

- If procurement has the CFO involved but there hasn't been a signed PO or confirmed payment term, move the close-date to 2026-11-30 and mark the opportunity "Commit - At Risk" in the Stage Reason field.
- Add a one-line next step: e.g., "Waiting on PO and legal sign-off; scheduled procurement call 10/18."
- If you think the CFO will push for an accelerated timeline and procurement can confirm payment terms by 10/15, leave as 10/21 and add note "503 - on track / need PO by 10/15".

I'll assign Marissa to help with any procurement outreach and to keep the forecast entry clean. Ben — please check whether we've already supplied the requested SOW details (was attached to the last engagement email).

Lauren
